text.insert: An append-only ledger of events: everything ever tried against a target. One canonical attempt shape covers upstream PRs, worker runs, and QA repairs: worker-run and QA-repair attempts are filed by the librarian from the run transcript + state (observed provenance); upstream-PR attempts remain inferred by the PR door. Events regime. Exists today: partial — PR co-touch only;
past_prs
is the raw material for the upstream-PR intake.

props.title: Discord is not a fourth intake

text.insert: The discord extraction pipeline is a fourth learning-producing lane, not an attempt intake — attempts stay PR / run / repair.
Every attempt carries
provenance: "observed" | "inferred"

. Worker runs and QA repairs are observed — we have the transcript, scores, and diffs. Past-PR attempts are inferred — reconstructed from the final diff and review comments, so the failures along the way are invisible. Efficacy math must not treat an inferred attempt's clean final diff as first-try success; inferred attempts under-report failures.
worker_checkpoints

is already the proto-attempt record: one row per attempt with before/after/delta/exact scores, timestamps, and gate flags. The graded outcomes map onto it directly — no score movement = failed, improved-but-not-exact = partial, exact = success. Observed attempts are therefore a transform over existing checkpoints plus the librarian's tactic overlay, not a new capture path.
Supersedes the
"worked": true
boolean in the sketch above: each
tactics[]
entry carries
outcome: "failed" | "partial" | "success"
— graded against score movement (
partial
= closer to 100% but not exact;
success
= 100%/exact) — plus a timestamp, and entries are ordered by timestamp so the sequence of what was tried, what failed, and what finally worked is reconstructible from the record.

fields.name: outcome

props.title: What agents exchange with the attempt ledger

text.insert: Tactics are a view, not a store
A tactic lives on attempts; attempts live on targets; targets are linked (siblings, analogs, peers).
So tactic retrieval is graph traversal:
by target
— "everything ever done to this file, its siblings, its analogs — and the tactics that worked there"
by tactic
— "this symptom → which tactics, validated on which attempts"
Vocabulary seeded from the ten mismatch-pattern categories currently hardcoded in
mismatch-patterns.ts
The extraction pass is re-runnable over the ledger, so a better extractor improves every tactic retroactively.
The symptom-keyed
tacticLookup
operation is cataloged on the
tactics file
Tactics now lives nested beneath this file as its child — a view over the ledger, not a separate store.
